write_up: You've moved from Line Cook to Sous Chef to Kitchen Manager, with ServSafe Manager certification. It's common for restaurant resumes to list the regular duties this way, but these lines won't stand out in a pile: a recruiter can see what the jobs cover, not yet how you ran the kitchen.

The strongest line gives the River Walk Grill kitchen a 180-seat setting. That's a useful model because it gives a recruiter something concrete to hold onto. The resume doesn't yet say how many kitchen staff you manage or what your day-to-day control of the kitchen includes.

Let's start with the River Walk Grill role. Add the team size and the parts of kitchen operations you run, then give the scheduling, ordering, inspection and training work a few details only you could provide.
